name: angle_y
label: Angle (RY)
description: One rotation per feature, no entanglement. Cheapest and the honest classical-simulable baseline: the kernel factorises into a product of per-qubit overlaps. Use it as the control.

name: angle_x2
label: Angle x2 (ring-entangled)
description: Encode, entangle with a CNOT ring, then re-encode. The ring sits between two data layers so it genuinely changes the kernel, unlike a trailing ring, which cancels.

name: zz
label: ZZ Feature Map (full entanglement)
description: Second-order Pauli-Z map with data-dependent two-qubit rotations. The pairwise angle depends on two features at once, which no product kernel can represent. Capped at 10 features because the gate count grows as N^2.

name: amplitude
label: Amplitude (log2 compression)
description: Packs N features into ceil(log2 N) qubits as state amplitudes. 16 features fit in 4 qubits. Cost moves from gate count into state preparation, which the simulator does for free and real hardware does not.
